All 6 tests are passing in this repository. The test suite appears to be working correctly with no failures. If there was a specific failing test that needs fixing, it may have already been resolved or the issue might have been transient.

- `int_to_roman()` converts integers to Roman numerals
- `roman_to_int()` converts Roman numerals to integers

All test cases for various inputs (simple numbers, 58, 4, 1994) are passing as expected.
